OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the entity types it imports.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: Time to wait between two runs of the connector, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `PT6H` for six hours). Every run reads the full rule set.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_API_URL.description: Base URL of the Splunk REST API (management port), e.g. `https://splunk.example.com:8089`.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_TOKEN.description: Splunk authentication token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Its user needs read access to the saved searches of the selected apps.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_APP.description: App namespace to read saved searches from. `-` reads every app.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_OWNER.description: Owner namespace to read saved searches from. `-` reads every owner.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_SEARCH_SCOPE.description: Saved searches to import: `correlation_searches` (Enterprise Security correlation searches only), `alerts` (correlation searches, scheduled searches that trigger alert actions, and saved searches annotated with ATT&CK techniques in `action.correlationsearch.annotations`) or `all`.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_WEB_URL.description: Base URL of Splunk Web, e.g. `https://splunk.example.com:8000`. When set, each Indicator links to its saved search.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_IMPORT_DISABLED_RU.description: Import saved searches that do not run (disabled or not scheduled) too, with the deployment status `deployed` (enabled and scheduled ones get `active`). When false, they are left out and count as removed.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout of each HTTP request, in seconds.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_MAX_RETRIES.description: Retries of a request failing with a rate limit (429), a server error (5xx) or a network error, with exponential backoff.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_VERIFY_SSL.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the Splunk REST API.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_PLATFORM_NAME.description: Name of the Security Platform the rules are deployed on in OpenCTI.

SPLUNK_SAVED_SEARCHES_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to every object this connector creates.
